title: lippia cuneifolia var. incisa
intro: Lippia cuneifolia var. incisa, commonly known as the cut-leaf lippia, is a plant species in the Verbenaceae family. It is a shrub native to southern Africa, known for its medicinal properties and uses. The plant has been reported to possess several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of various conditions such as fever, headache, and respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of Lippia cuneifolia var. incisa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory effects.
